# PRD — Restore a green `npm run check` (type-check health)

- **Status:** Draft
- **Created:** 2026-07-01
- **Owner:** _unassigned_
- **Related:** [Refactoring backlog](refactoring-backlog.md) (RF-01, RF-09), the
  "Not yet catalogued → Test suites" note therein.

## 1. Problem

`npm run check` (`svelte-check`) currently reports **118 errors across 24 files**.
A perpetually-red type check means:

- The signal is dead. New type regressions land unnoticed because "it's already
  red," so the tool no longer protects anyone.
- Real defects hide in the noise — several are genuine null-dereference and
  type-drift bugs in **production** code (see WS-1), not just test friction.
- Onboarding and AI-assisted edits are harder: a clean `check` is the fastest way
  to know a change is safe, and we can't offer that today.

The goal is to get `npm run check` to **0 errors** and keep it there via CI.

## 2. Scope

### In scope

The **112 errors** that are _not_ owned by the CSV-parser refactor — 7 in
production code, 105 in test/spec files. Grouped into four workstreams (§5).

### Explicitly out of scope (owned by RF-01)

These are tracked and fixed as part of
[RF-01 (CSV parser Template Method)](refactoring-backlog.md#rf-01--csv-parsers-duplicate-the-whole-parse-loop-template-method-gap):

- The **6 production type errors** in `src/lib/services/csvParsers/*.ts`
  (`AmexParser.ts:92`, `EQBankParser.ts:80`, `PCFinancialParser.ts:72`,
  `RBCFinancialParser.ts:93`, `SimpliiFinancialParser.ts:97`, `TDBankParser.ts:80`):
  `normalizeAmount()` returns `number | null` but is assigned straight into
  `ParsedTransaction.amount: number`. Consolidating the assignment into the
  Template Method is the natural place to fix this.
- The **`WealthSimpleParser.parse()` missing `try/catch`** inconsistency (the other
  six parsers wrap their body; Wealth Simple does not). RF-01's shared `parse()`
  template decides once whether the orchestration is wrapped, which resolves the
  divergence for all seven parsers.

> **Dependency:** the "0 errors" success metric (§4) is only fully met once **both**
> this PRD and RF-01 have landed. This PRD clears 112; RF-01 clears the last 6.
>
> **Status update:** RF-01 has **landed** — the 6 csvParsers errors above are fixed
> (consolidated into `BaseCSVParser.finalizeRow()`) and the Wealth Simple
> `try/catch` divergence is resolved. `npm run check` is now at **112 errors**
> (down from 118), i.e. exactly this PRD's remaining slice. The "0 errors" / green
> CI gate is unblocked on the RF-01 side and now waits solely on this PRD's four
> workstreams.

## 3. Goals / Non-goals

**Goals**

- `npm run check` exits 0.
- Add `npm run check` as a **required CI gate** so it can't silently regress.
- Do it without weakening type safety — no blanket `any`, no `// @ts-nocheck`,
  no disabling `svelte-check`. (Consistent with the repo's "no `any` even in
  tests" preference.)

**Non-goals**

- No behavioural changes to shipping features. This is a type-correctness and
  test-fixture effort.
- Not a general test-quality refactor (dedup, oversized specs) — that remains the
  backlog's deferred "Test suites" pass, though WS-3 lays useful groundwork.
- Not the `Money` / `LocalDate` value-object work (backlog RF-D1 / RF-D2).

## 4. Success metrics

| Metric                                      | Baseline | Target                                      |
| ------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------- |
| `npm run check` errors                      | 118      | **0** (with RF-01) / **6** (this PRD alone) |
| Files with problems                         | 24       | 0                                           |
| CI type-check gate                          | none     | required on every PR                        |
| New `any` / `@ts-*` suppressions introduced | —        | 0 (reviewed exceptions only)                |

## 5. Error inventory & workstreams

Counts below exclude the 6 RF-01 csvParsers errors.

### By file

| File                                                       |  Errors | Workstream |
| ---------------------------------------------------------- | ------: | ---------- |
| `src/lib/tests/family-category-visibility.spec.ts`         |      31 | WS-2       |
| `src/lib/services/ReceiptService.spec.ts`                  |      20 | WS-3       |
| `src/lib/services/CSVExportService.spec.ts`                |      15 | WS-3       |
| `src/lib/tests/expenses-page-filters.spec.ts`              |      10 | WS-4       |
| `src/lib/services/ReconciliationService.spec.ts`           |       9 | WS-3       |
| `src/lib/services/PDFExportService.spec.ts`                |       6 | WS-4       |
| `src/lib/services/ExpenseService.spec.ts`                  |       6 | WS-4       |
| `src/lib/tests/receipts-page.spec.ts`                      |       3 | WS-3       |
| `src/routes/expenses/+page.svelte`                         |       2 | WS-1       |
| `src/lib/services/OcrService.ts`                           |       2 | WS-1       |
| `src/routes/transactions/+page.svelte`                     |       1 | WS-1       |
| `src/lib/services/ReconciliationService.ts`                |       1 | WS-1       |
| `src/lib/services/PDFExportService.ts`                     |       1 | WS-1       |
| `src/lib/tests/reconciliation-foreign-currency.spec.ts`    |       1 | WS-3       |
| `src/lib/services/__tests__/ReconciliationService.test.ts` |       1 | WS-3       |
| `src/lib/services/ReceiptService.split.spec.ts`            |       1 | WS-3       |
| `src/lib/components/ReceiptImageViewer.spec.ts`            |       1 | WS-4       |
| `src/lib/components/ReceiptEditModal.spec.ts`              |       1 | WS-4       |
| **Total**                                                  | **112** |            |

---

### WS-1 — Production type & null-safety (7 errors) · **Priority: highest**

These are in shipping code and several are real bug risks, not test noise. Fix
first and independently of the rest.

| Site                            | Error                                                                                                                                                    | Likely fix                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| ------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `OcrService.ts:134`             | `chatResponse` possibly `undefined`; `ChatCompletionResponse \| undefined` assigned to `ChatCompletionResponse`                                          | Guard the Mistral SDK response before use; return a soft OCR failure if undefined (aligns with `feedback_ocr_resilience` — fail soft, no throw).                                                                              |
| `PDFExportService.ts:406`       | `Uint8Array<ArrayBufferLike>` not assignable to `BlobPart` (`SharedArrayBuffer` vs `ArrayBuffer`)                                                        | Normalize the buffer before `new Blob([...])` (e.g. copy into a fresh `Uint8Array`/`ArrayBuffer`); TS/lib-dom drift.                                                                                                          |
| `ReconciliationService.ts:12`   | Module `$lib/models/Reconciliation` has no exported member `DuplicateReceiptInfo`                                                                        | Dead/renamed import — remove or point at the current type.                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `expenses/+page.svelte:195,201` | Two different `Category` types — `$lib/services/CategoryService` (`color: string \| null`) vs `$lib/types/Category` (`color: string`) — are incompatible | Converge on one `Category` type (or make `color` nullable consistently). **Cross-ref [RF-09](refactoring-backlog.md#rf-09--three-inconsistent-ways-to-resolve-a-rows-category)** — the same Category-modelling inconsistency. |
| `transactions/+page.svelte:674` | `editRow` possibly `null`                                                                                                                                | Guard-clause / narrow before use.                                                                                                                                                                                             |

**Effort:** S–M. **Risk:** low, but touches shipping code → verify PDF export and
OCR paths manually after the change.

---

### WS-2 — Supabase mock returns `never` (31 errors) · **Priority: high**

All 31 errors in `family-category-visibility.spec.ts` share one root cause: the
test's Supabase client mock is untyped, so query-builder results collapse to
`never[]`. That produces both shapes seen:

- `Object literal may only specify known properties, and 'family_id' does not
exist in type 'never[]'` (on `.insert({...})`)
- `Property 'id' does not exist on type 'never'` (on `data!.id`)

**Fix:** type the mock query builder against the generated `Database` schema (or a
narrow typed helper) so `.from(...).insert(...).select().single()` resolves to the
real row type. One shared, correctly-typed Supabase mock helper fixes the whole
file and prevents recurrence. **Effort:** M. **Risk:** low (test-only).

---

### WS-3 — Stale row / DTO fixtures vs evolved schema (~63 errors) · **Priority: high**

The `ReceiptRow`, `Expense`, and `TransactionRow` types gained and lost fields
(consistent with the Jan–Feb 2026 foreign-currency and receipt migrations), but
the fixtures were never updated. Two sub-shapes:

- **Missing new fields** — fixtures omit `exchange_rate_to_cad`, `original_filename`,
  `matched_transaction_id`, `currency`. (`ReceiptService.spec.ts`,
  `CSVExportService.spec.ts`, `receipts-page.spec.ts`,
  `reconciliation-foreign-currency.spec.ts`, `ReceiptService.split.spec.ts`.)
- **Removed/renamed fields still present** — e.g. `updated_at` not in `ReceiptRow`,
  `plaid_transaction_id` not in `TransactionRow`. (`ReconciliationService.spec.ts`,
  `ReconciliationService.test.ts`.)

**Fix:** introduce shared typed fixture **builders** — `makeReceiptRow()`,
`makeExpense()`, `makeTransactionRow()` — returning fully-typed objects with sane
defaults and per-test overrides. Migrate the affected specs to them. This both
clears the errors and gives the deferred "Test suites" backlog item its missing
shared fixtures. **Effort:** M–L. **Risk:** low (test-only), but touches many files.

---

### WS-4 — Miscellaneous spec type errors (11 errors) · **Priority: medium**

Assorted, mostly independent: implicit-`any` parameters, possibly-`null` access, a
no-overlap comparison, and an argument-type mismatch. Files: `expenses-page-filters.spec.ts`
(10), `PDFExportService.spec.ts` (6), `ExpenseService.spec.ts` (6),
`ReceiptImageViewer.spec.ts` (1), `ReceiptEditModal.spec.ts` (1). Fix per-site:
annotate params, add null guards, correct call arguments. **Effort:** S–M.
**Risk:** low.

## 6. Sequencing

1. **WS-1** first — small, highest value (production correctness), unblocks a clean
   production surface independent of test churn.
2. **WS-2** — single-file, single root cause; big count reduction (31) for modest effort.
3. **WS-3** — build the fixture builders, then migrate specs; largest slice.
4. **WS-4** — mop up the remainder.
5. **Add the CI gate** once errors reach the RF-01-only floor (6), and flip to
   "required" the moment RF-01 lands (0). Land RF-01 and this PRD in either order;
   the gate turns green only when both are done.

Each workstream is independently shippable and leaves `check` no worse than before.

## 7. Risks & mitigations

- **Masking instead of fixing** — the tempting shortcut is `any`/`@ts-ignore`. Non-goal
  by policy; reviewers should reject suppressions without a written reason.
- **Fixture builders drift again** — mitigate by deriving builder types _from_ the
  real row/DTO types (so a future schema change breaks the builder, not 60 specs).
- **WS-1 touches shipping code** — manually verify PDF export and the OCR upload
  path; keep the OCR change fail-soft per `feedback_ocr_resilience`.

## 8. Open questions

- **Category type convergence (WS-1):** fix locally at the call site, or do the full
  RF-09 Category-modelling cleanup now? (Recommend: minimal local fix here, leave
  RF-09 as the structural follow-up.)
- **CI gate rollout:** block PRs immediately at the 6-error floor (allow-list the
  RF-01 files temporarily), or wait until RF-01 lands to flip the gate on?
- **Fixture builders location:** co-locate under `src/lib/tests/` or a new
  `src/lib/tests/builders/`?

</context>

## claude.ai Dropbox
# Claude App MCP LLM Boot Instructions

You are the assistant for Dropbox's Claude App MCP server. Your goal is to help users complete Dropbox tasks quickly and correctly while minimizing friction.

## Customer Use Cases

This app is best at helping users do these Dropbox workflows:

- Browse folder contents and paginate through large directories.
- Find files quickly using plain-language search terms and then open files with follow-on tools.
- Inspect file metadata (size, type, timestamps, IDs, sharing context).
- Check signed-in Dropbox identity, team/account context, and namespace-root context.
- Read text content from supported files up to 5 MiB, and provide a usable Dropbox link even when text extraction fails.
- Generate single-use temporary download links when the user explicitly needs direct file download URLs.
- Generate file previews with thumbnail and "open in Dropbox" experiences.
- Create folders in the right destination before saving artifacts.
- Create new text files directly in Dropbox.
- Create share links for files/folders and return the effective sharing settings.
- Inspect and list existing shared links.
- List, inspect, and create Dropbox file requests.
- Move, rename, copy, and delete Dropbox files/folders after explicit confirmation.
- Check the status of long-running move, copy, and delete jobs.

When users ask "what can you do?", summarize these use cases in plain language before taking action.

## Not Supported (Do Not Advertise)

- Editing or overwriting existing file content in place.
- Saving URL-hosted files directly into Dropbox.
- Uploading local/binary artifacts via `upload_file`.
- Permanent file deletion or wipe workflows. `delete` moves items to the user's Dropbox "Deleted files" area only.
- Reliable text extraction for supported files via `fetch`; extraction may still fail for some files, in which case the tool error may include a usable link.
- E-signature initiation or signing workflows.
- Actions outside Dropbox content management and sharing.

## Core Behavior

## devonthink
CRITICAL — Database package safety: DEVONthink databases are stored as packages (.dtBase2) or sparse images (.dtSparse, .dtArchive). Never modify, rename, move, or delete files inside a database package directly via the filesystem. All record and content operations must go through this MCP server or, as a fallback, via AppleScript. Direct filesystem manipulation will corrupt the database and cause irreversible data loss.

Batch operations: Use the uuids array parameter instead of sequential single-record calls for tag, update, move, trash, duplicate, replicate, and export operations. Batch mode is faster, reduces round trips, and returns a summary with succeeded/failed counts.

Avoiding duplicates: Use lookup_records (by name, URL, path, filename, or comment) before create_record to check whether a record already exists.

Content editing: Prefer update_record_content with mode append or insert over replace for large documents. Replace mode requires sending the entire new content and risks accidental data loss if the content is incomplete.

Group hierarchies: Use create_group_path to create nested group structures in a single call (like mkdir -p) rather than sequential create_record calls.

AI-powered tools: classify_record and find_similar_records use DEVONthink's built-in AI algorithms and proprietary training data — they provide organizational suggestions that complement, not duplicate, your own capabilities.

Record enrichment: resolve_doi_metadata and resolve_book_metadata can enrich existing records with bibliographic metadata by passing the record's uuid — there is no need to create a new record.

AI exclusion: Records marked as excluded from AI access (excludeFromChat) are protected in two ways. (1) Input protection: any tool that receives such a record's UUID as an argument refuses to operate on it and returns an error. (2) Output protection: result lists from tools like search_records, classify_record, find_similar_records, get_record_children, get_record_duplicates, and the link traversal tools are filt… [truncated]

content.content:
1	# Backlog
2	
3	The single working list — features, UX bugs, engineering, open questions, and
4	refactoring. Refactoring items are summarized here as one-liners; the full
5	detail (smell, effort, sibling sites, plan) lives in
6	[Refactoring backlog](refactoring-backlog.md), which is a reference, not a
7	separate to-do list.
8	
9	## Features
10	
11	- **Spending Report (v1).** New top-level `/spending` tab rolling up Expenses by Importance → Grouping → Category, months across, "Year to Date" total. Adds `importance_areas` + `category_groups` tables (Importance attaches to the Grouping) and `categories.group_id`, seeded from `docs/SampleHierachy.txt`. Client-side pure aggregation (`buildSpendingReport`), view-only, no editing UI. Uncategorized bucket included in Grand Total; refunds (negative amounts) net against spend. **Chart view (v0.60):** `Table | Chart` toggle adds a LayerChart stacked bar (bar per Grouping, stacked by month, sequential ramp; Importance as sub-label; click a bar to drill to Categories, breadcrumb back). Pure `buildSpendingChart`; render-tested. **Table cell drill-down (v0.55) ✅ DONE:** clicking a non-blank table cell opens `/expenses` filtered to exactly what it sums — category×month, category YTD, Grouping/Importance subtotals (expanded to member category ids), Uncategorized (`filter=uncategorized`), and Grand Total (date range only, ties out incl. Uncategorized). Pure `buildSpendingDrilldownParams` (8 tests); report rows/sections now carry ids (`categoryId`/group `id`/importance `id`). **Editable hierarchy — assign & re-parent (v0.65) ✅ DONE:** an **Edit hierarchy** page at `/spending/hierarchy` (button on `/spending`) lets the maintainer assign a Category to a Grouping (or Uncategorized) and move a Grouping to another Importance — closing the "custom/renamed categories stuck in Uncategorized" gap without SQL. Pure `buildHierarchyTree` (8 tests) + presentational `HierarchyEditor.svelte` (5 render tests); `CategoryService.assignCategoryToGroup` / `moveGroupToImportance`. Unassigned bucket surfaced up top. **Assign-on-create (v0.66) ✅ DONE:** the inline "Create new category…" form (expenses page `CategoryDropdown`) offers an optional Group selector so a new category is filed into a Grouping at birth instead of Uncategorized (`createCategory` gained an optional `groupId`; selector hidden when no groups passed, so receipt/reconciliation dropdowns are unchanged). **Historical-year expense upload (built, pending release) ✅ DONE:** an **Import Expenses** page at `/expenses/import` (buttons on `/expenses` and `/spending`) imports historical Expenses from CSV/XLS/XLSX (columns `Timestamp, Merchant, Amount, Category`; `Tag` ignored; Amount keeps its sign so refunds net). Each row → an imageless `receipts` row (no schema change — `receipt_image_path` nullable, `suspicious_date` false) + an `expense_categories` link; new category names are auto-created (land Uncategorized, warned in the preview). Two-step **preview → confirm** with count-based dedup (`date|merchant|amount|category`) so re-import is a no-op. Pure `parseExpenseImportCsv` (14) + `computeExpenseImportPlan`/`buildExpenseCategoryLinks` (12) + `ExpenseImportService` (7); the bank-parser CSV primitives were extracted to `csvPrimitives.ts` (base delegates; 229 parser tests unchanged). This **unblocks** prior-period overlay + year-over-year. Deferred: **chart-bar drill-down** (same affordance on the chart bars — carry the cell-link into `/expenses` from a bar/bracket click); **hierarchy tier CRUD** (create/rename/delete/reorder Groupings + Importance areas, with cascade-delete confirmations); prior-period overlay + year-over-year (now unblocked), quarter/period selection, multi-chart menu, export. See [Spending Report design](plans/2026-07-09-spending-report-design.md).
12	- **Delete a category (built, pending release) ✅ DONE.** Each category row in the hierarchy editor (`/spending/hierarchy`) now has a **Delete** button (`HierarchyEditor.onDeleteCategory`). The page confirms first, surfacing how many expenses are affected: the DB nulls the category on its expenses (`expense_categories.category_id ON DELETE SET NULL`, so history survives → they drop to Uncategorized) and cascade-removes any vendor rules (`vendor_category_rules … ON DELETE CASCADE`) — no blocking, since delete is DB-safe. The existing `CategoryService.deleteCategory` is reused; new `countCategoryExpenses` uses an exact `head` count (not a plain select, which the default 1000-row cap would undercount). Tests: 3 service specs + 2 `HierarchyEditor.svelte.spec` render tests.
13	- **Mass-change categories on the expenses page (built, pending release) ✅ DONE.** No dedicated bulk control: once multiple rows are selected (existing `DataTable` select-all/row checkboxes + `expenseSelection`), **picking a category on any selected row's own dropdown fans the change out to the whole selection** (`handleCategorySelect` routes to `applyCategoryToSelection` → `ExpenseService.bulkAssignCategory`, one batched upsert). A single checked row still takes the normal single-row path (keeps vendor-rule auto-creation); the bulk path deliberately skips vendor rules (a multi-row selection spans many merchants). A one-line hint appears while >1 row is selected. Two render tests in `expenses-page.svelte.spec.ts` (fan-out + single-row guard).
14	- **Receipt image — rotate.** Rotate left and right anywhere a receipt is viewed.
15	- **Profile — manage emails.** Let users add/edit the email addresses associated with their account.
16	- **Family editor.** Let a user create a family and then invite other users to join it.
17	- **iPhone camera.** Use the Camera app on iPhone to take photos of receipts.
18	- **Recent-categories dropdown & a11y _(optional UX, low priority)_.** Recent-categories dropdown section (exp2b), mobile-responsive category dropdown (exp8a), and category-dropdown ARIA/screen-reader support (exp8b) were specced but never built.
19	- **Specced-but-unbuilt UX bits _(optional, low priority)_.** Email-flow vendor auto-assignment (vca2a email path) and the read-only "Rate: 1 EUR = …" text in the receipt edit modal (fcr2b) were specced but not implemented.
20	
21	## Bugs / UX issues
22	
23	- **Receipt with No Date** - if a receipt has no date it is hard to find in the receipts view.
24	- **Category edit scrolls to top.** When a category is edited we always scroll back up to the top of the window.
25	- **Category dropdown clipped.** The category dropdown in the editor window is out of view when clicked.
26	- **Refunds counted as spending in PDF/CSV exports.** The PDF and CSV exporters `Math.abs()` amounts, so refunds (negative `total_amount`) are treated as spend instead of netting out. Worst case is `PDFExportService.calculateSubtotal` (`src/lib/services/PDFExportService.ts:176`), which _adds_ `abs(amount)` — a −$25.50 refund + $100 purchase totals **$125.50** instead of $74.50. The display formatters also strip the sign (`PDFExportService.ts:126`, `CSVExportService.ts:134`), so an exported refund prints as a positive purchase. The on-screen Spending report is correct (`spendingReport.ts:135` keeps refunds negative) — only the exports diverge. Note: current behaviour is deliberate and locked in by tests (`PDFExportService.spec.ts:199`, `CSVExportService.spec.ts:106`), so a fix must update those too. Low priority.
27	- **Blank transaction date hint.** When the transaction date is blank, show the expected date format for someone who is typing.
28	- **Unknown-sender email is silently dropped.** When a receipt is forwarded from an address not linked to any account, the webhook returns `404` and sends **no** notification — the sender gets no acknowledgement or error and the receipt never appears (`resend/index.ts:378-381`). Resend does not bounce/reply on a webhook error, so any feedback must be an email we send ourselves; deferred because auto-replying to unverified `From:` addresses is a backscatter/spoofing risk (would need SPF/DKIM gating + rate limiting). **End-user docs must flag this:** forward only from a registered email (primary or an additional email in your profile). See [Email notifications — scenario 7](email-notifications.md).
29	
30	## Engineering
31	
32	- **Remove the abandoned Spending Bridge (waterfall) view. ✅ DONE.** Built as a 3rd `/spending` view then abandoned as not intuitive — [ADR-0004](adr/0004-abandon-spending-bridge-waterfall-view.md) (reminder screenshot `docs/BridgeChartTooWide.png`). Deleted `SpendingBridge.svelte`, `spendingWaterfall.ts`, and their `.spec.ts`; stripped the `Bridge` toggle, render branch, `'bridge'` view type, and `priorReport` state from `src/routes/spending/+page.svelte`. Full suite green (1424), `check`/eslint/Prettier clean. The union-of-both-years approach (the code is gone — it was never committed, so not in git history; the idea is described in the ADR) is the one salvageable piece if **diverging change bars** are ever built to surface disappeared spend.
33	- **High vuln: `xlsx` (SheetJS) has no npm fix.** `npm audit` reports 1 high against `xlsx@^0.18.5` — Prototype Pollution ([GHSA-4r6h-8v6p-xvw6](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-4r6h-8v6p-xvw6), CVE-2023-30533, fixed in 0.19.3) and ReDoS ([GHSA-5pgg-2g8v-p4x9](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-5pgg-2g8v-p4x9), CVE-2024-22363, fixed in 0.20.2). Both fixes exist but **only on the SheetJS CDN (`cdn.sheetjs.com`), not npm** — the npm package is unmaintained, so `npm audit` will never clear and there's no fix version to bump to. Used only by the Excel importer, fully contained in `src/lib/services/ExcelToCSVConverter.ts` (`convertExcelToCSV`/`isExcelFile`, ~4 API calls) behind a stable interface; the app supports **both** legacy `.xls` (BIFF8) and `.xlsx` (tests build both, `ExcelToCSVConverter.test.ts`). Options: (a) pin the CDN tarball (`xlsx@https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/...` via `overrides`) — clears the CVEs, keeps `.xls` support, but adds a non-npm-registry dep that our `min-release-age` hardening can't gate; (b) migrate to `exceljs` — actively maintained, but **cannot read legacy `.xls`** (xlsx/csv only), so it would drop `.xls` support unless paired with a dedicated BIFF parser (`js-xls`). Decision needed on whether legacy `.xls` is still required. Deferred — the importer is not internet-exposed (users upload their own bank exports), which lowers the practical risk.
34	- **Low vulns: `cookie` (via `@sveltejs/kit`) and `esbuild` dev server.** `npm audit` reports 6 low-severity issues. (1) `cookie <0.7.0` accepts out-of-bounds characters in name/path/domain ([GHSA-pxg6-pf52-xh8x](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-pxg6-pf52-xh8x)), pulled in transitively through `@sveltejs/kit` → `@sveltejs/adapter-auto` / `runed` / `layerchart`; `npm audit fix --force` would downgrade `@sveltejs/kit` to `1.0.0-next.0` (breaking), so wait for the framework chain to bump `cookie` rather than force it. (2) `esbuild 0.27.3–0.28.0` allows arbitrary file read when the dev server runs on Windows ([GHSA-g7r4-m6w7-qqqr](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-g7r4-m6w7-qqqr)) — dev-only, non-Windows here; clearable with a plain `npm audit fix` (non-breaking). Low priority; both are dev/transitive, not shipped to users.
35	- **Expenses list capped at 1000 rows (large imports). ✅ DONE.** `ExpenseService.getExpenses` issued a single PostgREST query with no paging, so Supabase's default 1000-row cap silently truncated the result. After the historical importer added thousands of receipts, the expenses page (which loads all expenses then filters client-side) only held the newest 1000 — a Spending-report drill-down into an older year landed on "No results found — hiding all 1000 expenses", and the Spending report itself undercounted any year over 1000 rows. Fixed by paging `getExpenses` in 1000-row `.range()` batches until a short page (`fetchAllReceiptRows`); the shared Supabase mock gained `range`; 2 new pagination tests in `ExpenseService.getExpenses.spec.ts`. Reported via a `/spending` uncategorized drill-down.
36	- **Expenses page: date filter may go stale on Back nav (legacy `$page` store).** `src/routes/expenses/+page.svelte` derives its date filter from the URL via `$derived(readDateFilter($page.url.searchParams))` using the **legacy `$app/stores` `$page` store**. That's the same pattern that broke the Spending year selector: the `$page` store doesn't reliably re-track inside `$derived` across a remount, so after navigating away and pressing **Back** the URL can say one date range while the page renders another. Spending was ultimately fixed by reading the year in a **`+page.ts` `load`** (`data.year`) with the arrows using **`goto`** — `load` re-runs with the right URL on every navigation. (Client-side derivation off the page store did NOT hold up: both `$app/stores` `$page` and the `$app/state` reactive `page` went stale on Back.) Apply the same `load`-based pattern to the expenses date filter (and audit any other `$derived(... $page.url ...)` sites). Not yet reproduced/reported for expenses — latent. See the Spending report design doc and the URL-backed-state note.
37	- **`insert_receipt_with_context` RPC drops columns.** The RPC inserts only 9 columns and silently omits `suspicious_date` and `exchange_rate_to_cad` (`supabase/migrations/003_insert_receipt_rpc.sql`, and again in `20251010000319_remote_schema.sql`). The Resend email path passes both, so emailed receipts lose their suspicious-date flag and FX rate on the primary path (they only survive if the RPC errors into the direct-insert fallback). Fix: add both columns to the RPC insert (new migration) and confirm the remote function matches. Found while fixing the email-receipt null-date bug.
38	- **Test the Resend webhook handler. ✅ DONE.** `handleResendWebhook(req, deps)` extracted from `Deno.serve` into `supabase/functions/resend/handler.ts` (functional core) with `index.ts` reduced to the dep-wiring shell; `notify.ts` / `mistral.ts` / `exchangeRate.ts` gained optional `fetchFn`/`env` seams. The full branch matrix (rows 1–20: auth gates, body/attachment/fallback flow, notify-on-failure, foreign-currency) is covered in `handler.test.ts` (20 vitest cases, no network/Supabase/Deno). `deno check` clean on all production files. See [PRD — Make the Resend webhook handler testable](prd-resend-handler-testability.md).
39	- **PRD correction: Resend "no receipt" status is 422, not 404.** The testability PRD's §5 test plan lists `404` for row 18 (nothing found anywhere), but the deployed handler returns `422` — `404` is reserved for the unknown-sender case (row 10). The tests assert the real `422` (zero-behaviour-change goal); the PRD table row is the doc that's wrong. Low priority: fix the PRD table or leave the note.
40	- **Unmatched-expenses filter never finished.** `Expense.matched_transaction_id` is selected, populated, and unit-tested, but no Expenses-page UI consumes it — the "Hide Matched" toggle (umf1a/2a/3a) was specced but never built. Decide: build the toggle or drop the field.
41	- **Manually verify ReceiptImageViewer gestures.** The a11y fix moved wheel/mouse/touch listeners from Svelte markup handlers into a `use:gestureSurface` action (imperative `addEventListener`, `{ passive: false }`). Unit tests only cover logic, not real gestures — manually confirm wheel-zoom, drag-to-pan, pinch-zoom, and keyboard/screen-reader access still work.
42	- **`npm run lint` is fully green. ✅ DONE.** `npm run lint` (`prettier --check . && eslint .`) passes with exit 0 across the whole repo. Prettier: the repo is clean (`llm_history/`, a chat-log archive, added to `.prettierignore`). ESLint: triaged from 46 → 0. The last 26 were in the Deno edge functions (`supabase/functions/`) and were fixed by typing the payloads rather than relaxing the rule — a `SupabaseClient`/`InsertedReceipt` type alias in `resend/index.ts` + a shared `errText(unknown)` helper (`_shared/errText.ts`, unit-tested), a `RawOcrContent`/typed-env helper + module-scope `toNum(unknown)` in `_shared/mistral.ts`, `content_id?`/`content_disposition?` added to `ResendAttachment`, and the `deno-lint-ignore-file no-explicit-any` directives removed. Verified with `deno check` (both edited source files type-check clean). Note: `deno lint` still reports pre-existing `no-import-prefix` hints on the `https://esm.sh/...` imports — a Deno dependency-management style item, outside the repo's `npm run lint` gate.
43	
44	### Test-coverage backlog
45	
46	Optional, low-priority follow-ups — pure test coverage, no behaviour change.
47	
48	- **Expenses CSV export filename. ✅ DONE.** The inline filter→filename branching moved to `CSVExportService.expenseExportFilename()` (date range wins over category/uncategorized filters; single-category slug + `filtered` fallback preserved) and is unit-tested in `CSVExportService.spec.ts`; the page delegates. Teeth-proven.
49	- **`getSignedReceiptUrl()` edge cases. ✅ DONE.** New `signedUrl.spec.ts` pins the single-path contract: null/empty path → null with no storage call, storage-error → null (never throws), and the expiry (300s OCR / 3600s default) is forwarded to `createSignedUrl`.
50	- **PDF export dimensions & row numbering. ✅ DONE.** `PDFExportService.spec.ts` now loads the generated PDF and asserts every page is US-Letter (612×792), and (via a `drawText` spy) that summary row numbers restart at 1 per category. Both teeth-proven with induced breaks.
51	- **Resend handler orchestration. ✅ DONE.** The process-all-attachments loop and body-text fallback (eaf4a/eaf5a) are now covered by `handler.test.ts` after the handler was extracted into an importable `handleResendWebhook(req, deps)`. See [PRD — Make the Resend webhook handler testable](prd-resend-handler-testability.md).
52	
53	### Test-suite cleanup (quality only — no production-behavior change)
54	
55	Tidy the `*.spec.ts` suites. Each item is proven against an oracle or a real induced
56	failure, one spec file per PR-sized unit — see `.scratch/handoff-test-suite-cleanup.md`.
57	
58	- **Convert source-introspection specs → behavior tests. ✅ DONE.** All 10 `readFileSync`-their-own-source specs were converted to real behavior tests (render via the `*.svelte.spec.ts` harness or exercise the service/util directly) or deleted as redundant. Converting them surfaced a real false-positive bug-in-a-test (Profile link "visible to all users") and confirmed several bodies of logic were already covered by util/service specs. The last remaining source check — `auth-route-guard.spec.ts`'s `#{#ath1c}` no-per-page-redirect guard — was **deleted (2026-07-09)**: it only asserted the absence of one exact string literal (would pass through a `goto`/`location.assign`/backtick rewrite), the four protected pages carry no such self-redirect, and the layout gate is already behaviour-tested in `layout-render.svelte.spec.ts`. Verifying the pages themselves defer redirect to the layout is left to the per-page render slices.
59	- **Split oversized service specs. ✅ DONE (3 of 4; the 4th is single-concern).** Each split preserved the exact test set (oracle: identical passing count before/after).
60	  - `ExpenseService.spec.ts` (2165) → `ExpenseService.{getExpenses,categoryAssignment,vendorRules,matchStatus}.spec.ts` + shared `expenseServiceTestHelpers.ts` (105 tests).
61	  - `expenses-page-filters.spec.ts` (1404) → `expenses-filters.{uncategorized,categoryAnalytics,dateFilter,filterCount}.spec.ts` + shared `builders/expenseFilterFixtures.ts` (85 tests). _(These four were subsequently deleted/converted — the tests turned out to be reimplemented-logic; see the reimplemented-logic bullet below.)_
62	  - `ReceiptService.spec.ts` (1276) → `ReceiptService.{suspiciousDate,autoCategory,uploadMeta}.spec.ts` (44 tests). The `vi.mock` preamble is replicated per file (hoisting can't be shared via import).
63	  - `ReceiptService.split.spec.ts` (1024) — **left intact**: it is a single cohesive concern (the receipt-split feature) with a shared module-level `beforeEach`; concern-splitting a single-concern spec adds duplication for little gain.
64	- **Route inline row-building through the builders. ✅ DONE (small footprint).** `duplicateDetection.spec.ts`'s local `createReceipt` factory now delegates to `makeReceiptRow` (dropping an `as ReceiptRow` cast; oracle: 19 tests unchanged). Audit finding: most other "inline rows" are NOT builder candidates — they're partial Supabase query-result shapes (`ExpenseService.matchStatus`, `ReceiptService.autoCategory/uploadMeta` — the DB returns a subset of columns, not a full `ReceiptRow`), deliberate single-field minimal stubs (`reconciliationRowEdit.spec.ts`), or dead code (`duplicateHelpers.spec.ts`'s unused `createReceipt`). Forcing the builder into those would mis-shape the mock or add noise.
65	- **Foreign-currency amount cell render test. ✅ DONE.** The inline `total_amount * exchange_rate_to_cad` CAD-estimate math in the `amountCell` snippets of both `expenses/+page.svelte` and `receipts/+page.svelte` now has behavior coverage on the render harness: `expenses-page.svelte.spec.ts` and `receipts-page.svelte.spec.ts` render a foreign-currency (EUR, rate 1.53) row and assert `€45.00 (≈$68.85)`, plus a null-rate case that shows no estimate. Both production math sites were teeth-proven (turning `*` into `+` broke the estimate). No production extraction was needed after all — the harness made it directly testable.
66	- **Convert reimplemented-logic specs → real behavior/util tests. ✅ DONE.** The four `expenses-filters.*` specs tested locally-defined copies of the page's filter/analytics logic (`filterByCategory`, `calculateSpendingSummary`, `filterExpensesByURLDates`, …) — green whether or not the real code works. Resolved by routing each concern to its real owner: date-filter URL parse/generate/filter were **redundant** with `sharedDateFilter.spec.ts` (49 real tests) → deleted; the genuine `getValidDate` tests (its only coverage) **moved** to `dateValidation.spec.ts`; the uncategorized and category filters became **render tests** on the expenses page (`expenses-page.svelte.spec.ts` — toggle the Uncategorized button / pick a category, assert the visible rows + filtered count, both teeth-proven); sorting is owned by `DataTable.svelte.spec.ts`; the spending-summary reimplementation guarded **unbuilt UI** (no summary panel is rendered) → deleted. Net: ~82 hollow reimplementation tests replaced by real coverage. Also fixed a pre-existing `as any` in `dateValidation.spec.ts`. **Second-frontier sweep (follow-up):** two more offenders found and converted — (1) `CategoryDropdown.spec.ts` re-declared ~25 copies of the component's filter/validate/keyboard logic → replaced by a real render test `CategoryDropdown.svelte.spec.ts`, which **surfaced a production bug**: clicking "Create new category…" closed the whole dropdown (Svelte 5 flushes state synchronously after the delegated click handler, so the create button detaches before the document click-outside listener runs, which then treats the detached target as an outside click) — fixed in `CategoryDropdown.svelte` with an `isConnected` guard; (2) `transactions-page-filters.spec.ts` re-declared the page's `applyClientFilters`/`hasActiveFilters` → extracted the real predicate to `src/lib/utils/transactionFilters.ts` (page delegates), tested in `transactionFilters.spec.ts`. Both teeth-proven. **Third offender (later found):** `ReceiptImageViewer.spec.ts` (859 lines) was the worst of the lot — every `it()` re-declared the zoom arithmetic _inline_ (`let zoom = 100; zoom += 50; expect(zoom).toBe(150)`) and asserted against its own copy, never rendering the component (its header admitted it was stale TDD RED-phase scaffolding). The function-definition grep missed it precisely _because_ it inlines the logic rather than defining a helper — so the "no others remain" claim was wrong. Replaced with a render test `ReceiptImageViewer.svelte.spec.ts` (8 tests) that drives the real zoom buttons/keyboard and asserts the visible zoom %, disabled boundaries, and close wiring (teeth-proven; ~91 tautologies → 8 real). Pointer gestures (wheel/pan/pinch) remain the separate manual-verify item. Heuristic lesson: audit for _inline_ reimplementation, not just `function`-defined helpers.
67	- **Remove/implement unimplemented & placeholder tests. ✅ DONE (main finds).** (a) `CategoryService.spec.ts` was stale TDD **RED-phase scaffolding** — a dynamic `import()` in try/catch with a dead `if (!CategoryService) { expect.fail('not implemented yet'); return; }` guard in all 28 tests, even though the service has long existed. Stripped the scaffolding → static typed import; also replaced the whole `any`-typed mock with a typed `MockQueryBuilder` (24 `any`s → 0). 28 tests unchanged. (b) `CSVExportService.spec.ts`'s two empty `it.skip('… browser only')` placeholders → **implemented for real** in `CSVExportService.svelte.spec.ts` (client project): asserts the anchor download fires and — via raw-bytes (`EF BB BF`, since `Blob.text()` strips a leading BOM) — that the UTF-8 BOM is present for Excel. Teeth-proven. Non-finds: `ReceiptService.bulk.spec.ts`'s `expect.fail` are legit "should have thrown" guards. `family-category-visibility.spec.ts` — **decision made: KEEP.** It's an env-gated (`describeIf(SUPABASE_URL && SERVICE_KEY)`) RLS integration suite — never runs in CI, but it's the _only_ executable check of the family-scoping row-level-security policies the migrations define (removed members can't see data, unique constraints), which unit tests can't cover. Fixed a real bug (it re-evaluated `Date.now()` for the sign-in emails, so they never matched the `createUser` emails → every sign-in would fail); emails are now computed once per run, and the header documents how to run it against `supabase start`. A handful of hollow `expect(typeof service.X).toBe('function')` "has-method" checks remain, scattered one-per-suite — low value, not removed.

# Backlog

The single working list — features, UX bugs, engineering, open questions, and
refactoring. Refactoring items are summarized here as one-liners; the full
detail (smell, effort, sibling sites, plan) lives in
[Refactoring backlog](refactoring-backlog.md), which is a reference, not a
separate to-do list.

## Features

- **Spending Report (v1).** New top-level `/spending` tab rolling up Expenses by Importance → Grouping → Category, months across, "Year to Date" total. Adds `importance_areas` + `category_groups` tables (Importance attaches to the Grouping) and `categories.group_id`, seeded from `docs/SampleHierachy.txt`. Client-side pure aggregation (`buildSpendingReport`), view-only, no editing UI. Uncategorized bucket included in Grand Total; refunds (negative amounts) net against spend. **Chart view (v0.60):** `Table | Chart` toggle adds a LayerChart stacked bar (bar per Grouping, stacked by month, sequential ramp; Importance as sub-label; click a bar to drill to Categories, breadcrumb back). Pure `buildSpendingChart`; render-tested. **Table cell drill-down (v0.55) ✅ DONE:** clicking a non-blank table cell opens `/expenses` filtered to exactly what it sums — category×month, category YTD, Grouping/Importance subtotals (expanded to member category ids), Uncategorized (`filter=uncategorized`), and Grand Total (date range only, ties out incl. Uncategorized). Pure `buildSpendingDrilldownParams` (8 tests); report rows/sections now carry ids (`categoryId`/group `id`/importance `id`). **Editable hierarchy — assign & re-parent (v0.65) ✅ DONE:** an **Edit hierarchy** page at `/spending/hierarchy` (button on `/spending`) lets the maintainer assign a Category to a Grouping (or Uncategorized) and move a Grouping to another Importance — closing the "custom/renamed categories stuck in Uncategorized" gap without SQL. Pure `buildHierarchyTree` (8 tests) + presentational `HierarchyEditor.svelte` (5 render tests); `CategoryService.assignCategoryToGroup` / `moveGroupToImportance`. Unassigned bucket surfaced up top. **Assign-on-create (v0.66) ✅ DONE:** the inline "Create new category…" form (expenses page `CategoryDropdown`) offers an optional Group selector so a new category is filed into a Grouping at birth instead of Uncategorized (`createCategory` gained an optional `groupId`; selector hidden when no groups passed, so receipt/reconciliation dropdowns are unchanged). **Historical-year expense upload (built, pending release) ✅ DONE:** an **Import Expenses** page at `/expenses/import` (buttons on `/expenses` and `/spending`) imports historical Expenses from CSV/XLS/XLSX (columns `Timestamp, Merchant, Amount, Category`; `Tag` ignored; Amount keeps its sign so refunds net). Each row → an imageless `receipts` row (no schema change — `receipt_image_path` nullable, `suspicious_date` false) + an `expense_categories` link; new category names are auto-created (land Uncategorized, warned in the preview). Two-step **preview → confirm** with count-based dedup (`date|merchant|amount|category`) so re-import is a no-op. Pure `parseExpenseImportCsv` (14) + `computeExpenseImportPlan`/`buildExpenseCategoryLinks` (12) + `ExpenseImportService` (7); the bank-parser CSV primitives were extracted to `csvPrimitives.ts` (base delegates; 229 parser tests unchanged). This **unblocks** prior-period overlay + year-over-year. Deferred: **chart-bar drill-down** (same affordance on the chart bars — carry the cell-link into `/expenses` from a bar/bracket click); **hierarchy tier CRUD** (create/rename/delete/reorder Groupings + Importance areas, with cascade-delete confirmations); prior-period overlay + year-over-year (now unblocked), quarter/period selection, multi-chart menu, export. See [Spending Report design](plans/2026-07-09-spending-report-design.md).
- **Delete a category (built, pending release) ✅ DONE.** Each category row in the hierarchy editor (`/spending/hierarchy`) now has a **Delete** button (`HierarchyEditor.onDeleteCategory`). The page confirms first, surfacing how many expenses are affected: the DB nulls the category on its expenses (`expense_categories.category_id ON DELETE SET NULL`, so history survives → they drop to Uncategorized) and cascade-removes any vendor rules (`vendor_category_rules … ON DELETE CASCADE`) — no blocking, since delete is DB-safe. The existing `CategoryService.deleteCategory` is reused; new `countCategoryExpenses` uses an exact `head` count (not a plain select, which the default 1000-row cap would undercount). Tests: 3 service specs + 2 `HierarchyEditor.svelte.spec` render tests.
- **Mass-change categories on the expenses page (built, pending release) ✅ DONE.** No dedicated bulk control: once multiple rows are selected (existing `DataTable` select-all/row checkboxes + `expenseSelection`), **picking a category on any selected row's own dropdown fans the change out to the whole selection** (`handleCategorySelect` routes to `applyCategoryToSelection` → `ExpenseService.bulkAssignCategory`, one batched upsert). A single checked row still takes the normal single-row path (keeps vendor-rule auto-creation); the bulk path deliberately skips vendor rules (a multi-row selection spans many merchants). A one-line hint appears while >1 row is selected. Two render tests in `expenses-page.svelte.spec.ts` (fan-out + single-row guard).
- **Receipt image — rotate.** Rotate left and right anywhere a receipt is viewed.
- **Profile — manage emails.** Let users add/edit the email addresses associated with their account.
- **Family editor.** Let a user create a family and then invite other users to join it.
- **iPhone camera.** Use the Camera app on iPhone to take photos of receipts.
- **Recent-categories dropdown & a11y _(optional UX, low priority)_.** Recent-categories dropdown section (exp2b), mobile-responsive category dropdown (exp8a), and category-dropdown ARIA/screen-reader support (exp8b) were specced but never built.
- **Specced-but-unbuilt UX bits _(optional, low priority)_.** Email-flow vendor auto-assignment (vca2a email path) and the read-only "Rate: 1 EUR = …" text in the receipt edit modal (fcr2b) were specced but not implemented.

## Bugs / UX issues

- **Receipt with No Date** - if a receipt has no date it is hard to find in the receipts view.
- **Category edit scrolls to top.** When a category is edited we always scroll back up to the top of the window.
- **Category dropdown clipped.** The category dropdown in the editor window is out of view when clicked.
- **Refunds counted as spending in PDF/CSV exports.** The PDF and CSV exporters `Math.abs()` amounts, so refunds (negative `total_amount`) are treated as spend instead of netting out. Worst case is `PDFExportService.calculateSubtotal` (`src/lib/services/PDFExportService.ts:176`), which _adds_ `abs(amount)` — a −$25.50 refund + $100 purchase totals **$125.50** instead of $74.50. The display formatters also strip the sign (`PDFExportService.ts:126`, `CSVExportService.ts:134`), so an exported refund prints as a positive purchase. The on-screen Spending report is correct (`spendingReport.ts:135` keeps refunds negative) — only the exports diverge. Note: current behaviour is deliberate and locked in by tests (`PDFExportService.spec.ts:199`, `CSVExportService.spec.ts:106`), so a fix must update those too. Low priority.
- **Blank transaction date hint.** When the transaction date is blank, show the expected date format for someone who is typing.
- **Unknown-sender email is silently dropped.** When a receipt is forwarded from an address not linked to any account, the webhook returns `404` and sends **no** notification — the sender gets no acknowledgement or error and the receipt never appears (`resend/index.ts:378-381`). Resend does not bounce/reply on a webhook error, so any feedback must be an email we send ourselves; deferred because auto-replying to unverified `From:` addresses is a backscatter/spoofing risk (would need SPF/DKIM gating + rate limiting). **End-user docs must flag this:** forward only from a registered email (primary or an additional email in your profile). See [Email notifications — scenario 7](email-notifications.md).

## Engineering

- **Remove the abandoned Spending Bridge (waterfall) view. ✅ DONE.** Built as a 3rd `/spending` view then abandoned as not intuitive — [ADR-0004](adr/0004-abandon-spending-bridge-waterfall-view.md) (reminder screenshot `docs/BridgeChartTooWide.png`). Deleted `SpendingBridge.svelte`, `spendingWaterfall.ts`, and their `.spec.ts`; stripped the `Bridge` toggle, render branch, `'bridge'` view type, and `priorReport` state from `src/routes/spending/+page.svelte`. Full suite green (1424), `check`/eslint/Prettier clean. The union-of-both-years approach (the code is gone — it was never committed, so not in git history; the idea is described in the ADR) is the one salvageable piece if **diverging change bars** are ever built to surface disappeared spend.
- **High vuln: `xlsx` (SheetJS) has no npm fix.** `npm audit` reports 1 high against `xlsx@^0.18.5` — Prototype Pollution ([GHSA-4r6h-8v6p-xvw6](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-4r6h-8v6p-xvw6), CVE-2023-30533, fixed in 0.19.3) and ReDoS ([GHSA-5pgg-2g8v-p4x9](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-5pgg-2g8v-p4x9), CVE-2024-22363, fixed in 0.20.2). Both fixes exist but **only on the SheetJS CDN (`cdn.sheetjs.com`), not npm** — the npm package is unmaintained, so `npm audit` will never clear and there's no fix version to bump to. Used only by the Excel importer, fully contained in `src/lib/services/ExcelToCSVConverter.ts` (`convertExcelToCSV`/`isExcelFile`, ~4 API calls) behind a stable interface; the app supports **both** legacy `.xls` (BIFF8) and `.xlsx` (tests build both, `ExcelToCSVConverter.test.ts`). Options: (a) pin the CDN tarball (`xlsx@https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/...` via `overrides`) — clears the CVEs, keeps `.xls` support, but adds a non-npm-registry dep that our `min-release-age` hardening can't gate; (b) migrate to `exceljs` — actively maintained, but **cannot read legacy `.xls`** (xlsx/csv only), so it would drop `.xls` support unless paired with a dedicated BIFF parser (`js-xls`). Decision needed on whether legacy `.xls` is still required. Deferred — the importer is not internet-exposed (users upload their own bank exports), which lowers the practical risk.
- **Low vulns: `cookie` (via `@sveltejs/kit`) and `esbuild` dev server.** `npm audit` reports 6 low-severity issues. (1) `cookie <0.7.0` accepts out-of-bounds characters in name/path/domain ([GHSA-pxg6-pf52-xh8x](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-pxg6-pf52-xh8x)), pulled in transitively through `@sveltejs/kit` → `@sveltejs/adapter-auto` / `runed` / `layerchart`; `npm audit fix --force` would downgrade `@sveltejs/kit` to `1.0.0-next.0` (breaking), so wait for the framework chain to bump `cookie` rather than force it. (2) `esbuild 0.27.3–0.28.0` allows arbitrary file read when the dev server runs on Windows ([GHSA-g7r4-m6w7-qqqr](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-g7r4-m6w7-qqqr)) — dev-only, non-Windows here; clearable with a plain `npm audit fix` (non-breaking). Low priority; both are dev/transitive, not shipped to users.
- **Expenses list capped at 1000 rows (large imports). ✅ DONE.** `ExpenseService.getExpenses` issued a single PostgREST query with no paging, so Supabase's default 1000-row cap silently truncated the result. After the historical importer added thousands of receipts, the expenses page (which loads all expenses then filters client-side) only held the newest 1000 — a Spending-report drill-down into an older year landed on "No results found — hiding all 1000 expenses", and the Spending report itself undercounted any year over 1000 rows. Fixed by paging `getExpenses` in 1000-row `.range()` batches until a short page (`fetchAllReceiptRows`); the shared Supabase mock gained `range`; 2 new pagination tests in `ExpenseService.getExpenses.spec.ts`. Reported via a `/spending` uncategorized drill-down.
- **Expenses page: date filter may go stale on Back nav (legacy `$page` store).** `src/routes/expenses/+page.svelte` derives its date filter from the URL via `$derived(readDateFilter($page.url.searchParams))` using the **legacy `$app/stores` `$page` store**. That's the same pattern that broke the Spending year selector: the `$page` store doesn't reliably re-track inside `$derived` across a remount, so after navigating away and pressing **Back** the URL can say one date range while the page renders another. Spending was ultimately fixed by reading the year in a **`+page.ts` `load`** (`data.year`) with the arrows using **`goto`** — `load` re-runs with the right URL on every navigation. (Client-side derivation off the page store did NOT hold up: both `$app/stores` `$page` and the `$app/state` reactive `page` went stale on Back.) Apply the same `load`-based pattern to the expenses date filter (and audit any other `$derived(... $page.url ...)` sites). Not yet reproduced/reported for expenses — latent. See the Spending report design doc and the URL-backed-state note.
- **`insert_receipt_with_context` RPC drops columns.** The RPC inserts only 9 columns and silently omits `suspicious_date` and `exchange_rate_to_cad` (`supabase/migrations/003_insert_receipt_rpc.sql`, and again in `20251010000319_remote_schema.sql`). The Resend email path passes both, so emailed receipts lose their suspicious-date flag and FX rate on the primary path (they only survive if the RPC errors into the direct-insert fallback). Fix: add both columns to the RPC insert (new migration) and confirm the remote function matches. Found while fixing the email-receipt null-date bug.
- **Test the Resend webhook handler. ✅ DONE.** `handleResendWebhook(req, deps)` extracted from `Deno.serve` into `supabase/functions/resend/handler.ts` (functional core) with `index.ts` reduced to the dep-wiring shell; `notify.ts` / `mistral.ts` / `exchangeRate.ts` gained optional `fetchFn`/`env` seams. The full branch matrix (rows 1–20: auth gates, body/attachment/fallback flow, notify-on-failure, foreign-currency) is covered in `handler.test.ts` (20 vitest cases, no network/Supabase/Deno). `deno check` clean on all production files. See [PRD — Make the Resend webhook handler testable](prd-resend-handler-testability.md).
- **PRD correction: Resend "no receipt" status is 422, not 404.** The testability PRD's §5 test plan lists `404` for row 18 (nothing found anywhere), but the deployed handler returns `422` — `404` is reserved for the unknown-sender case (row 10). The tests assert the real `422` (zero-behaviour-change goal); the PRD table row is the doc that's wrong. Low priority: fix the PRD table or leave the note.
- **Unmatched-expenses filter never finished.** `Expense.matched_transaction_id` is selected, populated, and unit-tested, but no Expenses-page UI consumes it — the "Hide Matched" toggle (umf1a/2a/3a) was specced but never built. Decide: build the toggle or drop the field.
- **Manually verify ReceiptImageViewer gestures.** The a11y fix moved wheel/mouse/touch listeners from Svelte markup handlers into a `use:gestureSurface` action (imperative `addEventListener`, `{ passive: false }`). Unit tests only cover logic, not real gestures — manually confirm wheel-zoom, drag-to-pan, pinch-zoom, and keyboard/screen-reader access still work.
- **`npm run lint` is fully green. ✅ DONE.** `npm run lint` (`prettier --check . && eslint .`) passes with exit 0 across the whole repo. Prettier: the repo is clean (`llm_history/`, a chat-log archive, added to `.prettierignore`). ESLint: triaged from 46 → 0. The last 26 were in the Deno edge functions (`supabase/functions/`) and were fixed by typing the payloads rather than relaxing the rule — a `SupabaseClient`/`InsertedReceipt` type alias in `resend/index.ts` + a shared `errText(unknown)` helper (`_shared/errText.ts`, unit-tested), a `RawOcrContent`/typed-env helper + module-scope `toNum(unknown)` in `_shared/mistral.ts`, `content_id?`/`content_disposition?` added to `ResendAttachment`, and the `deno-lint-ignore-file no-explicit-any` directives removed. Verified with `deno check` (both edited source files type-check clean). Note: `deno lint` still reports pre-existing `no-import-prefix` hints on the `https://esm.sh/...` imports — a Deno dependency-management style item, outside the repo's `npm run lint` gate.

### Test-coverage backlog

Optional, low-priority follow-ups — pure test coverage, no behaviour change.

- **Expenses CSV export filename. ✅ DONE.** The inline filter→filename branching moved to `CSVExportService.expenseExportFilename()` (date range wins over category/uncategorized filters; single-category slug + `filtered` fallback preserved) and is unit-tested in `CSVExportService.spec.ts`; the page delegates. Teeth-proven.
- **`getSignedReceiptUrl()` edge cases. ✅ DONE.** New `signedUrl.spec.ts` pins the single-path contract: null/empty path → null with no storage call, storage-error → null (never throws), and the expiry (300s OCR / 3600s default) is forwarded to `createSignedUrl`.
- **PDF export dimensions & row numbering. ✅ DONE.** `PDFExportService.spec.ts` now loads the generated PDF and asserts every page is US-Letter (612×792), and (via a `drawText` spy) that summary row numbers restart at 1 per category. Both teeth-proven with induced breaks.
- **Resend handler orchestration. ✅ DONE.** The process-all-attachments loop and body-text fallback (eaf4a/eaf5a) are now covered by `handler.test.ts` after the handler was extracted into an importable `handleResendWebhook(req, deps)`. See [PRD — Make the Resend webhook handler testable](prd-resend-handler-testability.md).

### Test-suite cleanup (quality only — no production-behavior change)

Tidy the `*.spec.ts` suites. Each item is proven against an oracle or a real induced
failure, one spec file per PR-sized unit — see `.scratch/handoff-test-suite-cleanup.md`.

- **Convert source-introspection specs → behavior tests. ✅ DONE.** All 10 `readFileSync`-their-own-source specs were converted to real behavior tests (render via the `*.svelte.spec.ts` harness or exercise the service/util directly) or deleted as redundant. Converting them surfaced a real false-positive bug-in-a-test (Profile link "visible to all users") and confirmed several bodies of logic were already covered by util/service specs. The last remaining source check — `auth-route-guard.spec.ts`'s `#{#ath1c}` no-per-page-redirect guard — was **deleted (2026-07-09)**: it only asserted the absence of one exact string literal (would pass through a `goto`/`location.assign`/backtick rewrite), the four protected pages carry no such self-redirect, and the layout gate is already behaviour-tested in `layout-render.svelte.spec.ts`. Verifying the pages themselves defer redirect to the layout is left to the per-page render slices.
- **Split oversized service specs. ✅ DONE (3 of 4; the 4th is single-concern).** Each split preserved the exact test set (oracle: identical passing count before/after).
  - `ExpenseService.spec.ts` (2165) → `ExpenseService.{getExpenses,categoryAssignment,vendorRules,matchStatus}.spec.ts` + shared `expenseServiceTestHelpers.ts` (105 tests).
  - `expenses-page-filters.spec.ts` (1404) → `expenses-filters.{uncategorized,categoryAnalytics,dateFilter,filterCount}.spec.ts` + shared `builders/expenseFilterFixtures.ts` (85 tests). _(These four were subsequently deleted/converted — the tests turned out to be reimplemented-logic; see the reimplemented-logic bullet below.)_
  - `ReceiptService.spec.ts` (1276) → `ReceiptService.{suspiciousDate,autoCategory,uploadMeta}.spec.ts` (44 tests). The `vi.mock` preamble is replicated per file (hoisting can't be shared via import).
  - `ReceiptService.split.spec.ts` (1024) — **left intact**: it is a single cohesive concern (the receipt-split feature) with a shared module-level `beforeEach`; concern-splitting a single-concern spec adds duplication for little gain.
- **Route inline row-building through the builders. ✅ DONE (small footprint).** `duplicateDetection.spec.ts`'s local `createReceipt` factory now delegates to `makeReceiptRow` (dropping an `as ReceiptRow` cast; oracle: 19 tests unchanged). Audit finding: most other "inline rows" are NOT builder candidates — they're partial Supabase query-result shapes (`ExpenseService.matchStatus`, `ReceiptService.autoCategory/uploadMeta` — the DB returns a subset of columns, not a full `ReceiptRow`), deliberate single-field minimal stubs (`reconciliationRowEdit.spec.ts`), or dead code (`duplicateHelpers.spec.ts`'s unused `createReceipt`). Forcing the builder into those would mis-shape the mock or add noise.
- **Foreign-currency amount cell render test. ✅ DONE.** The inline `total_amount * exchange_rate_to_cad` CAD-estimate math in the `amountCell` snippets of both `expenses/+page.svelte` and `receipts/+page.svelte` now has behavior coverage on the render harness: `expenses-page.svelte.spec.ts` and `receipts-page.svelte.spec.ts` render a foreign-currency (EUR, rate 1.53) row and assert `€45.00 (≈$68.85)`, plus a null-rate case that shows no estimate. Both production math sites were teeth-proven (turning `*` into `+` broke the estimate). No production extraction was needed after all — the harness made it directly testable.
- **Convert reimplemented-logic specs → real behavior/util tests. ✅ DONE.** The four `expenses-filters.*` specs tested locally-defined copies of the page's filter/analytics logic (`filterByCategory`, `calculateSpendingSummary`, `filterExpensesByURLDates`, …) — green whether or not the real code works. Resolved by routing each concern to its real owner: date-filter URL parse/generate/filter were **redundant** with `sharedDateFilter.spec.ts` (49 real tests) → deleted; the genuine `getValidDate` tests (its only coverage) **moved** to `dateValidation.spec.ts`; the uncategorized and category filters became **render tests** on the expenses page (`expenses-page.svelte.spec.ts` — toggle the Uncategorized button / pick a category, assert the visible rows + filtered count, both teeth-proven); sorting is owned by `DataTable.svelte.spec.ts`; the spending-summary reimplementation guarded **unbuilt UI** (no summary panel is rendered) → deleted. Net: ~82 hollow reimplementation tests replaced by real coverage. Also fixed a pre-existing `as any` in `dateValidation.spec.ts`. **Second-frontier sweep (follow-up):** two more offenders found and converted — (1) `CategoryDropdown.spec.ts` re-declared ~25 copies of the component's filter/validate/keyboard logic → replaced by a real render test `CategoryDropdown.svelte.spec.ts`, which **surfaced a production bug**: clicking "Create new category…" closed the whole dropdown (Svelte 5 flushes state synchronously after the delegated click handler, so the create button detaches before the document click-outside listener runs, which then treats the detached target as an outside click) — fixed in `CategoryDropdown.svelte` with an `isConnected` guard; (2) `transactions-page-filters.spec.ts` re-declared the page's `applyClientFilters`/`hasActiveFilters` → extracted the real predicate to `src/lib/utils/transactionFilters.ts` (page delegates), tested in `transactionFilters.spec.ts`. Both teeth-proven. **Third offender (later found):** `ReceiptImageViewer.spec.ts` (859 lines) was the worst of the lot — every `it()` re-declared the zoom arithmetic _inline_ (`let zoom = 100; zoom += 50; expect(zoom).toBe(150)`) and asserted against its own copy, never rendering the component (its header admitted it was stale TDD RED-phase scaffolding). The function-definition grep missed it precisely _because_ it inlines the logic rather than defining a helper — so the "no others remain" claim was wrong. Replaced with a render test `ReceiptImageViewer.svelte.spec.ts` (8 tests) that drives the real zoom buttons/keyboard and asserts the visible zoom %, disabled boundaries, and close wiring (teeth-proven; ~91 tautologies → 8 real). Pointer gestures (wheel/pan/pinch) remain the separate manual-verify item. Heuristic lesson: audit for _inline_ reimplementation, not just `function`-defined helpers.
- **Remove/implement unimplemented & placeholder tests. ✅ DONE (main finds).** (a) `CategoryService.spec.ts` was stale TDD **RED-phase scaffolding** — a dynamic `import()` in try/catch with a dead `if (!CategoryService) { expect.fail('not implemented yet'); return; }` guard in all 28 tests, even though the service has long existed. Teeth-proven. Non-finds: `ReceiptService.bulk.spec.ts`'s `expect.fail` are legit "should have thrown" guards. `family-category-visibility.spec.ts` — **decision made: KEEP.** It's an env-gated (`describeIf(SUPABASE_URL && SERVICE_KEY)`) RLS integration suite — never runs in CI, but it's the _only_ executable check of the family-scoping row-level-security policies the migrations define (removed members can't see data, unique constraints), which unit tests can't cover. ## What I did

**1. CI gate → Product Backlog** (`docs/product-backlog.md`, Engineering section)

It calls for a GitHub Actions workflow running `check`/`lint`/`test` on every PR, and flags the `npm ci` requirement so our `min-release-age` hardening isn't bypassed.

- Status `Draft` → `Done (2026-07-17)`, added a `Completed:` line.

**3. Established a convention for completed PRDs**
Chosen convention: **completed PRDs live in `docs/prd-done/`; active PRDs stay as `docs/prd-*.md`.** So `ls docs/prd-*.md` = active, `ls docs/prd-done/` = finished — status is visible without opening a file.
